name: expr-mask-length-distance
author: Claude
description: Exercises length() and distance() in a mask, so the GPU interpreter's ops 38/39 render. A localPosition bake centres each geometry at [0.5, 0.5, 0.5] with its radius at 0.5; red = a distance() sphere around the centre, green = the same field via length(). The two are exact complements, so correct ops render every texel at full red+green brightness (red core fading to green extremities); a dark hole or brightness dip means the GPU ops disagree with the CPU.

pos.note: Each texel the vertex position, normalized per geometry: centre [0.5, 0.5, 0.5], radius 0.5

nearCentre.note: 1 at the geometry's centre, 0 at its radius; distance() reduces the vec3 texel to a scalar

farFromCentre.note: The exact complement of nearCentre, via length() of the offset vector

outputs.note: Red + green sum to full brightness everywhere when ops 38/39 are correct
